headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY MORNING

periods.name: Today
periods.text: West winds 15 to 25 knots becoming northwest. A chance of showers through early afternoon, then showers late. Waves 2 to 4 feet building to 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally around 6 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: North winds to 30 knots. A chance of showers in the evening. Waves 3 to 6 feet building to 4 to 7 feet. Waves occasionally around 9 feet.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: North winds 15 to 25 knots becoming northwest and diminishing to 5 to 15 knots. Sunny. Waves 3 to 6 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

periods.name: Saturday night
periods.text: West winds 10 knots or less becoming southwest. Clear. Waves 2 feet or less.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Sunday through Tuesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 65 degrees, off Cleveland 66 degrees, and off Erie 64 degrees.

headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH SATURDAY AFTERNOON

periods.name: Today
periods.text: Southwest winds to 30 knots becoming west. Showers likely with a slight chance of thunderstorms early, then a chance of showers. Showers late. Waves 3 to 6 feet building to 5 to 9 feet. Waves occasionally around 11 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Northwest winds to 30 knots becoming north. Showers in the evening, then a chance of showers overnight. Waves 6 to 10 feet. Waves occasionally around 13 feet.

periods.name: Saturday
periods.text: North winds to 30 knots becoming northwest and diminishing to 5 to 10 knots in the afternoon. Mostly sunny. Waves 6 to 9 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet. Waves occasionally around 11 feet.

periods.name: Saturday night
periods.text: West winds 5 to 10 knots becoming southwest. Clear. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

notes: Winds and waves higher in and near thunderstorms.
See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Sunday through Tuesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 65 degrees, off Cleveland 66 degrees, and off Erie 64 degrees.
